Starting Point: Building a More Editorial Portfolio

Jun 14, 2026

This is the kind of post that gives the site a stronger identity.

What I changed

I moved away from a resume-style homepage and started treating the site like a small publication: shorter navigation, clearer visual hierarchy, and room for writing.

What I want to add next

  • A technical post about one project
  • Screenshots and charts
  • A tighter project index

Why it matters

A portfolio becomes more memorable when it shows how you think, not just what you know.
